reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM retail_transactions;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS unique_invoices FROM retail_transactions;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) AS unique_stock_codes FROM retail_transactions;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS unique_countries, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM retail_transactions;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS positive_quantity_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE quantity > 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS negative_quantity_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE quantity < 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_above_100 FROM retail_transactions WHERE price > 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_at_least_500 FROM retail_transactions WHERE price >= 500;
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY country ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions WHERE invoice_date >= TIMESTAMP '2011-11-01' AND invoice_date < TIMESTAMP '2011-12-01';

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date AS transaction_month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM retail_transactions;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS average_unit_price FROM retail_transactions;
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 10000 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;
SELECT country, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions WHERE invoice_date >= TIMESTAMP '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < TIMESTAMP '2011-04-01';

SELECT TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'FMDay') AS weekday, EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM invoice_date)::INTEGER AS weekday_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'FMDay'), EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM invoice_date) ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly_counts AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::INTEGER AS transaction_year, DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date AS transaction_month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date), DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)), ranked_months AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY transaction_year ORDER BY transaction_count DESC) AS month_rank FROM monthly_counts) SELECT transaction_year, transaction_month, transaction_count FROM ranked_months WHERE month_rank = 1 ORDER BY transaction_year;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::INTEGER AS transaction_year, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) ORDER BY transaction_year;
validation_note: 2009 represents only December, so it is a partial calendar year.

reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_customer_ids FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_descriptions FROM retail_transactions WHERE description IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS both_missing FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NULL AND description IS NULL;
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS missing_customer_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY missing_customer_records DESC, country ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS invoice_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY invoice_count DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC, country ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers, ROUND(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) AS records_per_customer FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) >= 10 ORDER BY records_per_customer DESC, country ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS invoice_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_records DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT stock_code, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY transaction_records DESC, stock_code ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT stock_code, COUNT(DISTINCT description) AS distinct_descriptions, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY distinct_descriptions DESC, transaction_records DESC, stock_code ASC LIMIT 10;
validation_note: COUNT(DISTINCT description) excludes NULL descriptions, whereas COUNT(*) includes all transaction records, including those with missing descriptions.

reference_sql: SELECT stock_code, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity < 0) AS negative_quantity_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE stock_code IN ('POST', 'DOT', 'M', 'C2', 'D', 'BANK CHARGES', 'ADJUST', 'AMAZONFEE', 'CRUK', 'B', 'm', 'ADJUST2') GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY negative_quantity_records DESC, stock_code ASC;
SELECT stock_code, COUNT(*) AS missing_description_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE description IS NULL GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY missing_description_records DESC, stock_code ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT CASE WHEN invoice LIKE 'C%' THEN 'C-prefixed' ELSE 'Other' END AS invoice_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS distinct_invoices, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY invoice_type ORDER BY transaction_records DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN invoice LIKE 'C%' THEN 'C-prefixed' ELSE 'Other' END AS invoice_type, COUNT(*) AS negative_quantity_records, SUM(quantity) AS total_negative_quantity FROM retail_transactions WHERE quantity < 0 GROUP BY invoice_type ORDER BY negative_quantity_records DESC;

SELECT invoice, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity >= 0) AS non_negative_quantity_records FROM retail_transactions WHERE invoice LIKE 'C%' GROUP BY invoice HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity >= 0) > 0 ORDER BY non_negative_quantity_records DESC, invoice ASC;

SELECT CASE WHEN invoice LIKE 'C%' THEN 'C-prefixed' ELSE 'Other' END AS invoice_type, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE price = 0) AS zero_price_records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE price < 0) AS negative_price_records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE price > 0) AS positive_price_records FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY invoice_type ORDER BY invoice_type;

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS invoice_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) >= 100 AND SUM(quantity) > 10000 ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 10;
validation_note: Filters to records with known Customer IDs and positive quantities before grouping. All counts and sums are based only on qualifying records.

reference_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM retail_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) >= 10 AND COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, country ASC LIMIT 10;
validation_note: Excludes records with missing Customer IDs. Countries must have at least 10 distinct known customers and more than 1,000 records. Total quantity includes positive and negative quantities.

reference_sql: SELECT stock_code, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS distinct_invoices, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS average_unit_price FROM retail_transactions WHERE stock_code ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND price >= 10 AND quantity > 0 GROUP BY stock_code HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, stock_code ASC LIMIT 10;
validation_note: Only numeric-only StockCodes with price >= 10 and positive quantity are included. At least 100 qualifying records are required per StockCode. Average price uses qualifying records only.

reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::DATE AS transaction_month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity > 0) AS positive_quantity_records, SUM(quantity) FILTER (WHERE quantity > 0) AS positive_total_quantity FROM retail_transactions GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30000 AND SUM(quantity) FILTER (WHERE quantity > 0) >= 100000 ORDER BY positive_total_quantity DESC, transaction_month ASC;
validation_note: Groups all records by calendar month. Months must have at least 30,000 total records and at least 100,000 positive total quantity. Positive record count and positive quantity exclude zero and negative quantities.
